name: Mistral Mcp
description: Exposes the full Mistral AI API surface to Claude Code through a local MCP server: 22 tools (chat, streaming, embeddings, OCR, vision, Voxtral transcription and speech, Codestral FIM, agents, moderation, classification, files, batch), 2 live-fetched resources (model catalog, voice catalog), and 6 curated prompts. Ships 5 namespaced skills optimized for everyday workflows: code review via Codestral, Conventional Commits messages in French, meeting minutes from audio or text, B2B invoice reminders in French, and a meta-skill that routes tasks to the right Mistral model. Auto-installs the mistral-mcp npm package on first use; API key is stored in Claude Code's secrets storage and never written to settings.json.
longDescription:
Ships **11 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (11): `audio-dispatch` (Transcribe a meeting audio file with Voxtral diarization, classify each speaker's turns by intent, and produce a per-speaker…), `codestral-review` (Reviews a code diff through Codestral with an auto-detected focus (correctness, performance, security, or api_design)), `compliance-audit-workflow` (Run a compliance audit Mistral Workflow, query mid-run findings via workflow_interact(action="query"), and signal approval or escalation decisions at…), `contract-analyzer` (OCR a contract PDF with mistral_ocr, then extract structured clauses and risk scores with mistral_chat + json_schema), `contract-review-workflow` (Trigger a deployed Mistral Workflow for contract review, poll execution status, detect human-in-the-loop checkpoints via workflow_interact(query), collect approval…), `french-commit-message` (Génère un message de commit git en français au format Conventional Commits à partir des changements stagés), `french-invoice-reminder` (Rédige une relance de facture B2B en français avec un ton contrôlé (poli, ferme, ou final)), `french-meeting-minutes` (Génère un compte-rendu de réunion structuré en français à partir d'une transcription brute ou d'un fichier audio), and 3 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `mistral`

Installs with `claude plugin install mistral-mcp@claude-community` from `Swih/mistral-mcp` (`claude-plugin`).
